product_family: Marketing automation platform including email marketing, CRM, SMS and WhatsApp messaging, landing pages, and AI-powered automation via Active Intelligence (v2.8 at assessment date)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center compliance section explicitly lists 'SOC 2 Type 2' and provides 'ActiveCampaign SOC 2 Type 2 Report' as a downloadable resource. The trust center FAQ also confirms the report is available upon written request no more than once a year.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center compliance section lists GDPR. ActiveCampaign acts as a data processor, provides a signed DPA, supports data subject rights (access, erasure, portability), and has obtained EU adequacy under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: ActiveCampaign is certified under three data privacy frameworks: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (effective July 11, 2023), UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (effective October 12, 2023), and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (effective September 15, 2024). Trust center resources list 'ActiveCampaign Certification to the Data Privacy Framework'.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center compliance section explicitly lists 'CCPA COMPLIANT' and provides 'ActiveCampaign CCPA Information' as a standalone resource.

certifications.name: HIPAA (BAA available on eligible plans)
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center compliance section lists HIPAA. Trust center FAQ includes 'Is ActiveCampaign willing to sign a BAA?' as a listed question. Vendor blog states 'Business Associate Agreement (BAA): Available on eligible plans to cover the use and disclosure of PHI' with the Professional tier (~$229/mo) cited as an example qualifying plan.

certifications.name: Google CASA Tier 2
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center compliance section lists 'Google CASA Tier 2' as a compliance line item (displayed alongside SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 is not listed in the trust center compliance section, which enumerates only SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, and Google CASA Tier 2. Third-party security profile aggregators claim this certification, but no vendor-domain page confirms it.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27701 certification found on any accessible ActiveCampaign domain page or trust center.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 AI governance certification found on any accessible ActiveCampaign domain page or trust center.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Claimed by a third-party security profile aggregator, but not listed in ActiveCampaign's own trust center compliance section or any vendor-domain security page.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: A third-party profile claims 'CSA STAR Level 1 Compliant' (the self-assessment tier). ActiveCampaign does not appear in the publicly searchable portion of the CSA STAR registry, and no vendor-domain page confirms this.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Third-party security profile aggregators claim PCI compliance. ActiveCampaign is a marketing automation platform and does not appear to directly process payment card data in scope of PCI DSS. No vendor-domain page confirms a PCI DSS certification or SAQ/AoC.

privacy.ai_training_note: The Terms of Service (section 4) explicitly state: 'we may view, copy, and internally use Marketing Content to help us train and improve the Services, including their functionality and effectiveness.' Contact data is also used 'to train, detect issues with our Services, and to ensure their proper functioning.' The Active Intelligence product page states the AI is 'trained on billions of real customer interactions across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more' but adds that 'while Active Intelligence learns from aggregated patterns across our platform to improve recommendations, your specific customer information and campaigns are never shared with anyone else.' This creates a notable tension: the ToS permits training on customer Marketing Content with no explicit opt-out mechanism, while marketing materials emphasize only anonymized/aggregated patterns are used. AI-generated outputs 'may not be unique across users' (ToS section 5.3). No opt-out for AI training on aggregated data exists.
privacy.data_region: Multi-regional data centers in the US, EU (Ireland), and APAC. Accounts are automatically assigned to the closest region by GEO IP at account creation; customers cannot manually select a region. Importantly, contact data continues to be processed in the United States and other locations outside the hosting region regardless of the assigned data center, per the Multi-Regional Data Hosting Policy.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Implied by Web Application Firewall and Zero Trust Network Access controls listed in trust center; explicit TLS confirmation not extracted from accessible pages.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Not explicitly confirmed in accessible vendor pages; single-tenancy architecture and world-class data centers referenced but no specific algorithm or AES standard stated.

security.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
security.value: MFA available on all customer accounts; required per NIST standards for internal personnel. Configurable idle session timeouts.

security.name: Single Sign-On (SSO)
security.value: SSO available as a product security feature.

security.name: Zero Trust Network Access
security.value: Listed as an active infrastructure control in trust center.

security.name: Web Application Firewall
security.value: Listed as an active network security control in trust center.

security.name: Architecture
security.value: Single-tenancy architecture; each customer's data is isolated. Separate production environment listed as a trust center control.

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Continuous penetration testing by internal Red Team; pen test attestation available in trust center. Bug bounty program via Bugcrowd.

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Daily vulnerability scanning; static code analysis; open-source package management; in-house tooling for anomalous activity detection.

security.name: Endpoint Security
security.value: Endpoint security and MDM system listed as active infrastructure controls in trust center.

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Minimum necessary access principle; regular audits of user access permissions; personnel MFA required per NIST.

security.name: AI Controls
security.value: Trust center lists three AI-specific controls: AI policy, AI Features, and Third-Party AI Diligence.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Trust center lists: Amazon Web Services (cloud provider), Cloudflare (cloud monitoring), Snowflake (data storage and processing), Zendesk (customer support service); full list available in trust center. New subprocessors posted with 7-day objection window before deemed consent.

products.name: Email Marketing and Automation
products.data_scope: Contact data (names, email addresses, behavioral tracking, IP), email content (Marketing Content), campaign metrics, form submissions
products.notes: Core product; automation workflows, segmentation, A/B testing. Contact data in scope of DPA. Marketing Content explicitly usable by ActiveCampaign to train/improve services per ToS section 4.

products.name: CRM (Deals and Contacts)
products.data_scope: Deals pipeline data, contact records, interaction history, employment and occupation data
products.notes: Built-in CRM; not available as a standalone product. Subject to same DPA and ToS terms as core platform.

products.name: Active Intelligence (AI automation)
products.data_scope: Marketing Content, customer interaction history, brand kit assets, aggregate behavioral patterns from platform-wide data
products.notes: AI features generate email and SMS content and automation suggestions. ToS section 4 permits use of Marketing Content to train and improve services. No opt-out. AI-generated content 'may not be unique across users' (ToS 5.3). Trust center lists AI policy, AI Features, and Third-Party AI Diligence as controls.

products.name: SMS and WhatsApp Marketing
products.data_scope: Phone numbers, message content, opt-in consent records
products.notes: Available as additional channels within the core platform subscription.

products.name: Landing Pages
products.data_scope: Form submissions, visitor behavior, IP addresses
products.notes: Built-in landing page builder integrated with automation workflows.

compare.pricing_model: Per-contact subscription tiers (Starter, Plus, Professional, Enterprise); pricing scales with contact count. Professional tier cited at approximately $229/month for BAA eligibility.
compare.data_residency: Multi-regional (US, EU, APAC); automatic GEO IP assignment at account creation; no customer-controlled region selection. Contact data is still processed in the US regardless of hosting region.

flags: ToS section 4 permits ActiveCampaign to view, copy, and internally use Marketing Content to help train and improve the Services. This is broader than the Active Intelligence marketing page, which states only 'aggregated patterns' are used and individual customer data is not shared. No opt-out mechanism for AI training on customer data exists.

ISO 27001 is not listed in the trust center compliance section (which lists SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, Google CASA Tier 2). Third-party security profile aggregators claim this certification, but ActiveCampaign has not provided direct on-domain confirmation such as a certificate in the trust center.
FedRAMP is claimed by a third-party aggregator but not listed on any ActiveCampaign domain page.
CSA STAR Level 1 (self-assessment) is claimed by a third-party profile but not confirmed via the CSA STAR registry or ActiveCampaign's own pages.

PCI DSS compliance is claimed by a third-party aggregator. ActiveCampaign does not appear to directly process card-holder data in scope of PCI DSS as a marketing automation platform, and there is no vendor-domain evidence for this certification.

HIPAA BAA is available only on eligible plans, at minimum the Professional tier per the vendor's blog. Starter and Plus plans do not qualify. Healthcare buyers should verify current plan eligibility before assuming HIPAA coverage.

Contact data continues to be processed in the United States even when accounts are hosted in the EU or APAC region, per the vendor's Multi-Regional Data Hosting Policy. This limits GDPR data-transfer protection to the hosting layer only.
Full certification documents and detailed controls require account login or an explicit access request. This limits public verifiability of some controls and the SOC 2 Type 2 report itself.
